answer: Yarrow is a bitter root: worthless in bulk, precious one rhizome at a time. So set the protocol's dilution parameter such that each new account's vote weight decays with the square root of its signup-cohort size. A ring that floods one epoch dilutes its own nectar into an ocean of near-zero shares, while a steady solo grower keeps full weight. Attacker cost: beating sqrt-dilution forces every fake to age alone across several epochs — trading one night of scripting for a season of patient, checkable presence.
